items.text: Birthright citizenship should be ended
items.rationale: Advocates ending automatic citizenship for people born in the U.S., a restrictive immigration and citizenship position conventionally associated with the political right and nationalist politics.

items.text: Inheritance should be heavily taxed
items.rationale: Advocates a strong tax on inherited wealth, a redistributive policy conventionally associated with the left and progressive efforts to reduce wealth inequality.

items.text: Assault weapons should be banned
items.rationale: Advocates a ban on a class of firearms, a gun-control position conventionally associated with the political left in U.S. politics.

items.text: Transgender women should be allowed to compete in women's sports
items.rationale: Advocates transgender inclusion in women's sports, a position conventionally associated with the political left and progressive LGBTQ rights politics in current U.S. debates.

items.text: Hate speech should be illegal
items.rationale: The claim advocates legal restrictions on hateful expression, a stance commonly associated with left-of-center anti-discrimination and equality politics. Its exact placement varies by country and free-speech tradition, so confidence is medium.

items.text: The United States should impose high tariffs on Canadian imports
items.rationale: The claim advocates protectionist trade barriers against another country. In current U.S. politics, this kind of aggressive tariff policy is most associated with nationalist right-wing politics, though protectionism can also appear outside the right.

items.text: Federal Bureau of Prisons management should be able to change staffing and discipline rules without union approval
items.rationale: The claim advocates limiting union power and giving management more flexibility, a position conventionally associated with center-right labor policy, especially in the public sector.

items.text: All recreational drugs should be legalized
items.rationale: The claim advocates ending legal prohibitions on recreational drug use, a clear civil-liberties position strongly associated with libertarianism. Its left-right placement is not singular because drug legalization is supported by some on both the left and the libertarian right.

items.text: The United States should stop policing the world
items.rationale: The claim advocates a non-interventionist foreign policy, opposing the U.S. role as a global military enforcer. This position appears on both the left and right, so no single left-right leaning is assigned.

items.text: Governments should borrow for infrastructure during recessions even with high public debt
items.rationale: The claim endorses countercyclical deficit spending and public investment, a position commonly associated with center-left Keynesian fiscal policy, though it can also be supported by some centrists.

items.text: Donald Trump posted on Truth Social ... that Jerome Powell should be forced to resign ...
items.rationale: The claim reports what Donald Trump posted, without endorsing the position itself.

items.text: Representative Don Bacon stated that the United States should not turn its back on Afghan allies ...
items.rationale: The claim reports Representative Don Bacon's stated position rather than endorsing it directly.

items.text: The US should split the childhood MMR vaccine into three separate doses
items.rationale: The claim advocates a vaccine delivery policy, but support for splitting the MMR vaccine is not clearly located on the left-right spectrum and can stem from varied health or safety concerns.

items.text: GLP-1 medications should be covered by public insurance for obesity treatment
items.rationale: Advocates expanding public insurance coverage for a medical treatment, a mainstream center-left health policy position favoring broader public healthcare support.

items.text: Suspected measles patients should be immediately isolated ...
items.rationale: This is clinical infection-control guidance about isolating suspected measles patients, not a political position about policy or society.

items.text: Standard two-step serologic testing should be part of Lyme disease diagnosis when indicated
items.rationale: This is clinical guidance about diagnostic testing for Lyme disease and does not take a political position.

items.text: Pennsylvania measles outbreak reaches 1,004 cases across 39 counties ...
items.rationale: The claim reports public health case counts and geographic spread without advocating a policy or political position.

items.text: SAMHSA reinstated $2 billion in mental health and substance use grants ... following bipartisan pushback.
items.rationale: The claim reports a government action and the political reaction to it without endorsing or opposing the grants.

items.text: The US government should restrict the use of unhosted cryptocurrency wallets
items.rationale: The claim advocates restricting unhosted cryptocurrency wallets, but support for crypto restrictions can stem from financial regulation, anti-money-laundering enforcement, national security, or consumer protection concerns across the political spectrum. Its left-right placement is context-dependent rather than clearly conventional.

items.text: The societal debate should focus on finding the right balance of financial rules, not eliminating them entirely.
items.rationale: The claim advocates a moderate regulatory stance, rejecting total deregulation while not calling for expansive regulation. That is best characterized as centrist rather than a specific ideology.

items.text: The Liquid Network suffered a $320 million exploit in September 2026 ...
items.rationale: The claim reports an alleged cryptocurrency hack and its ranking by size without advocating any political position.

items.text: Right-leaning pollsters were paid to conduct polling to convince Donald Trump to scale back deportations ...
items.rationale: The claim reports an alleged political strategy and actions by pollsters involving Donald Trump, without endorsing or advocating the immigration position itself.

items.text: The US should reject global schemes to control AI
items.rationale: The claim advocates rejecting international or global governance over AI in favor of U.S. autonomy, a stance commonly associated with nationalist, right-leaning politics. The wording is explicit, though the exact ideological placement could vary depending on context.

items.text: AI companies should be required to make their systems more transparent
items.rationale: The claim advocates a regulatory requirement on private AI companies to increase transparency, a position generally associated with mainstream center-left support for corporate oversight. Its placement is somewhat debatable because AI transparency has some cross-partisan appeal.

items.text: Advanced Machine Intelligence raised $1.03 billion in a March 2026 seed round
items.rationale: The claim reports a funding amount and date for a company without advocating any political position.

items.text: Disney should aggressively integrate generative AI into its creative production
items.rationale: The claim gives business/creative production strategy advice about using generative AI, without taking a clear political stance on law, rights, labor policy, or governance.

items.text: Jerusalem should be divided between Israel and Palestine
items.rationale: Advocates a territorial compromise consistent with a two-state framework, a position commonly associated with center-left or left peace-process politics in the Israel-Palestine context. The exact left-right placement varies by audience, so confidence is medium.

items.text: Poland should reintroduce border checks with EU neighbors to monitor transit
items.rationale: Advocates reinstating border controls within the EU, a restrictive border and sovereignty-oriented policy conventionally associated with the mainstream right or center right.

items.text: The Yemeni government's July 2026 bombing of Sanaa airport was justified
items.rationale: The claim endorses a specific military action in Yemen, but support for that bombing does not map reliably onto a left-right political leaning or named ideology without more context.

items.text: The margin of victory between the left-leaning opposition and the right-wing bloc in Sweden's ... election was approximately 50,000 votes
items.rationale: The claim neutrally reports an election result and vote margin without endorsing either side or a policy position.

items.text: The entry of Ethiopian government forces into northern Tigray towns ... heightened geopolitical tensions
items.rationale: The claim reports a military movement and its geopolitical effect without advocating a policy or political position.

items.text: The study found 80% of ChatGPT's responses were exclusively left-leaning, while 3% were right-leaning.
items.rationale: The claim reports a study's finding about ChatGPT responses rather than endorsing a political position itself.

items.text: A group known as the Integrists believes that the Catholic church should run the country.
items.rationale: The claim reports what a group known as the Integrists believes rather than endorsing the position itself.

items.text: Populist parties on both the left and the right are making inroads with the UK electorate.
items.rationale: The claim reports a political trend about populist parties gaining support without endorsing or opposing that development.

items.text: The two-minute rule states that a new habit should be scaled down to an action that takes two minutes or less.
items.rationale: The claim describes a habit-formation rule and has no political or ideological stake.

items.text: Marriage should be between a man and a woman
items.rationale: The claim endorses a traditional, opposite-sex-only definition of marriage, a socially conservative position associated with the political right.

items.text: A man should head the family in regards to making certain decisions
items.rationale: The claim endorses a patriarchal family hierarchy and traditional gender roles, which are conventionally associated with right-wing social conservatism and traditionalism.

items.text: Same-sex unions remove the ability to procreate, with the exception of adoption
items.rationale: The claim asserts a factual proposition about procreation in same-sex unions without directly advocating a policy or normative political position.

items.text: Partners in a committed relationship should share their phone passcodes
items.rationale: This is personal relationship advice about boundaries and privacy between partners, not a political position about law, policy, rights, the economy, or governance.

items.text: A woman should have input on date plans to ensure her time and energy are well-spent ...
items.rationale: This is personal dating advice about how couples should plan dates, not a political claim about law, rights, policy, or social organization.

items.text: In contemporary dating, individuals have the freedom to choose what they want in a relationship
items.rationale: The claim concerns personal relationship choice in dating and does not advocate a political policy, law, or broader governmental position.
